name: Vampire - Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only) - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a attack

results.text: The vampire lunges with inky talons outstretched, fangs glinting under the moonlight's cruel glow.
A blur of shadow strikes as the undead predator closes the distance between prey and fang.
Crimson eyes lock onto their target as the vampire coils like a serpent ready to strike.
The air chills as the vampire's form materializes, fingers curling into claws with lethal intent.
With a whisper of movement, the ancient horror moves in for the kill, shadows writhing around them.
